name: web-minimal-centered-hero-with-dark-teal-pill-logo-and-icon-button
title: White hero with a dark teal rounded wordmark, two-line lorem text, a black camera-icon button and an arrow link
whatItIs: A white page with a centred dark slate-teal rounded wordmark 'LOOO', a black bold line and a grey second line of placeholder text, and below a black rounded button with a camera icon and a text link 'Dolor Sit Amet ->'.
whatItMeans: Neutral and open; a stripped hero shows structure before content.
techniques: Stack logo, headline and buttons on a centre line.
Pair a black filled button with a text link.
Use dark teal for the logo only.

vocabulary.definition: A hero with everything centred on one axis.
An arrow link next to a primary button.
Lorem ipsum text used in a template.
A button with an icon and a label.
